candidate_region: Concow / Magalia / Paradise area, Butte County
wildfire_relevance: Site of the 2018 Camp Fire, the deadliest and most destructive wildfire in California history (85 deaths, 18,000+ structures destroyed). Steep canyon and ridge terrain with limited evacuation routes.
underserved_relevance: Concow and Magalia are unincorporated, lower-income mountain communities with older housing stock and limited services. CDC/ATSDR SVI can quantify this directly at the census-tract level.
fire_data: Strong. Dense NASA FIRMS coverage plus historical fire perimeter data from CAL FIRE FRAP.
population_data: Strong. WorldPop plus US Census ACS block-group data.
roads: Strong. OpenStreetMap is well mapped for this area.
boundaries: Strong. GADM plus US Census TIGER boundaries both apply cleanly.
community_assets: Strong. Schools and clinics are fairly completely tagged in OSM for this area.
environmental_data: Strong. ESA WorldCover, NASA POWER, and MODIS NDVI all have full coverage with no gaps.
smoke_aqi_data: Strong. EPA AirNow has monitoring stations in and near Butte County.
strongest_source_links: CAL FIRE FRAP fire perimeters; CDC/ATSDR SVI; EPA AirNow.
limitations: Already heavily studied after the Camp Fire, so less novel as a case. Canyon terrain may need higher-resolution road data than default OSM exports provide.

candidate_region: Mescalero Apache Reservation / Ruidoso area, Lincoln and Otero Counties
wildfire_relevance: Site of the 2024 South Fork and Salt Fires, which started on Mescalero Apache tribal trust land, grew past 15,000 acres in 24 hours, and forced roughly 5,000 evacuations amid extreme drought.
underserved_relevance: Mescalero Apache Reservation is federally recognized tribal land, rural and historically underserved by both public services and public mapping infrastructure.
fire_data: Strong. NASA FIRMS covers it the same as anywhere; BIA Mescalero Agency and InciWeb incident reports can supplement.
population_data: Moderate. WorldPop covers the area, but Census ACS data for tribal statistical areas is less granular and less reliable than standard county data.
roads: Weak to moderate. OpenStreetMap coverage on tribal trust land is typically sparser than surrounding non-tribal areas.
boundaries: Moderate. GADM has county-level boundaries but does not reliably represent tribal reservation boundaries; would need a BIA or Census TIGER tribal boundary file as a supplement.
community_assets: Weak. Schools and clinics on tribal land are less consistently tagged in OpenStreetMap.
environmental_data: Strong. ESA WorldCover, NASA POWER, and MODIS NDVI are global datasets and cover it fully.
smoke_aqi_data: Moderate. EPA AirNow station coverage is thinner in rural New Mexico than in Butte County.
strongest_source_links: BIA Mescalero Agency incident reports; InciWeb; National Drought Mitigation Center.
limitations: Tribal sovereignty and data-sharing norms mean some official layers are not publicly mapped at the same detail as elsewhere. Boundaries and roads need a tribal-specific data supplement, not just GADM/OSM defaults.
feasibility_score: 3 of 5 (moderate, real gaps in roads, assets, and boundary precision)

candidate_region: Mati and nearby rural wildland-urban interface villages, Attica
wildfire_relevance: Site of the 2018 Mati wildfire, one of the deadliest wildfires in modern European history (104 deaths). Classic wildland-urban interface risk with narrow, informally built roads and limited egress.
underserved_relevance: Mati and similar rural Attica villages have a large retiree and elderly population and grew through unauthorized or informal development with weak infrastructure planning.
fire_data: Strong. NASA FIRMS is a global dataset and covers this area fully.
population_data: Moderate. WorldPop covers it, but there is no CDC SVI equivalent. A true social vulnerability index would need Eurostat or Greece's ELSTAT data, which has not been vetted yet.
roads: Strong. OpenStreetMap has good coverage across Greece and Europe generally.
boundaries: Strong. GADM covers Greek administrative units cleanly.
community_assets: Moderate. OSM tagging of clinics and schools is decent in Europe overall but less consistent in small rural villages.
environmental_data: Strong. ESA WorldCover is a European-led product and performs especially well here; NASA POWER and MODIS NDVI both apply.
smoke_aqi_data: Weak. EPA AirNow does not apply outside the US. Would need the EU Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service or Greece's national air quality network, which has sparse rural station coverage.
strongest_source_links: Peer-reviewed case studies on the 2018 Attica wildfires (MDPI, Springer); European Parliament resolution documenting the disaster.
limitations: Vulnerability index and AQI data both require substituting non-US sources not yet in the source tracker. Best candidate for testing how well the project generalizes outside the US, but requires more upfront research.
feasibility_score: 3 of 5 (moderate, two full data categories need new sources)
